title: Puzzle 2d Inspector Kind Dropdowns
description: Details panel does not show dropdown for node, handle, and edge kinds when graph objects are selected. Add kind catalog selects mirroring puzzle 3d inspector.
summary: Added kind-catalog Select dropdowns to the puzzle 2d Details inspector for selected nodes (nodeKind), handles (handleKind), and edges (edgeKind), mirroring puzzle 3d. Introduced puzzle2dPlayKindCatalogSelectItems, puzzle2dApplyNodeKindToFixtureNode, edgeKind on fixture edges with parse/descriptor forwarding, and tests.
